The awareness campaign was held in five Chennai Metro Rail stations – Alandur, Airport, Vadapalani, Egmore, and Chennai Central. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
Members of the Rotary Club of Chennai Coastal and other Rotary Clubs of Rotary International District 3234 held a public awareness campaign on Saturday. This was held as part of World Polio Day.
The awareness campaign was held in five Chennai Metro Rail stations – Alandur, Airport, Vadapalani, Egmore, and Chennai Central, according to a press release. The members decorated the station premises with banners and standees, and distributed flyers to commuters.
Rotary District Governor D. Suresh Jain visited the stations, along with Rotary Club presidents, secretaries, and district officers -Dhanasekar, Palani, and T.S.P. Purushotham respectively, the release said.
